name: Goose
summary: A long neck, very straight, very white.
text:
Tall and white, with a long neck and an orange beak. The legs are fine wood and the light comes through the body.

Very simple lines — right for a room that does not want much colour in it.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
